attributes.description: Reference to the parent client account (project owner, developer, or sponsor) to which this contact belongs. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Account object.

attributes.name: mailing_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.address. Business justification: contact stores five inline mailing address fields (mailing_street, mailing_city, mailing_state, mailing_postal_code, mailing_country) that duplicate the purpose of the address table. Adding mailing_ad

attributes.name: reports_to_contact_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the contact's direct manager or superior within the client organisation. Enables hierarchical stakeholder mapping and organisational chart modelling for large client accounts.

attributes.name: account_manager
attributes.description: Full name of the internal account manager or business development representative responsible for managing the relationship with this contact. Used for ownership assignment and pipeline accountability in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: birthdate
attributes.description: Date of birth of the contact. Stored for relationship personalisation purposes (e.g., milestone acknowledgements) and identity verification in regulated markets. Handled under strict GDPR data minimisation principles.

attributes.name: client_segment
attributes.description: Segment classification of the client organisation associated with this contact. Supports client segmentation analytics across public-sector, private-sector, Public-Private Partnership (PPP), Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), and Joint Venture (JV) arrangements.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record within the CRM system. 'active' indicates an engaged stakeholder; 'inactive' indicates no recent engagement; 'archived' indicates the contact has left the organisation; 'do_not_contact' indicates a communication opt-out or legal restriction.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact's functional role in the client relationship (e.g., owner representative, technical representative, procurement officer, legal counsel, executive sponsor, financial approver). Drives stakeholder engagement strategy and communication routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: owner|technical|procurement|legal|executive|financial|hse|commercial — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the contact record was first created in the source Salesforce CRM system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and CRM record age analytics in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: crm_contact_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this contact as recorded in Salesforce CRM Contact object. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing back to the operational system of record.

attributes.name: data_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contact's data processing consent was last recorded or updated. Required for GDPR compliance audit trails to demonstrate lawful basis for processing personal data.

attributes.name: data_consent_status
attributes.description: Current status of the contact's consent for personal data processing under applicable privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA). Tracks whether consent has been granted, withdrawn, is pending confirmation, or is not required (e.g., legitimate interest basis).

attributes.name: decision_authority_level
attributes.description: Indicates the contact's level of decision-making authority within the client organisation for construction project approvals, contract awards, and change order authorisations. Supports bid strategy and stakeholder influence mapping.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organisational department or business unit within the client organisation to which the contact belongs (e.g., Engineering, Procurement, Legal, Finance). Supports targeted stakeholder engagement and communication routing.

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates that this contact has opted out of all marketing and non-essential communications, or that a legal restriction prevents outreach. Enforces GDPR Article 21 right to object and CAN-SPAM compliance in Salesforce CRM campaign management.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the contact used for official project correspondence, RFI responses, bid submissions, and CRM communication tracking. Sourced from Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: email_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has opted out of email marketing communications specifically. Distinct from do_not_contact which covers all channels. Enforces GDPR consent management and CAN-SPAM compliance.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the individual stakeholder contact as recorded in Salesforce CRM. Used for personalised correspondence and formal communication in client relationship management.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Complete display name of the contact (e.g., salutation + first + last name) as stored in Salesforce CRM. Used in formal correspondence, bid submissions, and contract administration documents.

attributes.name: influence_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–10) representing the contact's level of influence over project award decisions, contract negotiations, and change order approvals. Used in bid strategy and stakeholder mapping for major infrastructure pursuits.

attributes.name: is_decision_maker
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has final decision-making authority for contract awards, change orders (CO), or project approvals. Critical for bid management and opportunity pipeline qualification in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: is_executive_sponsor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact holds the role of executive sponsor for the client relationship. Executive sponsors are senior client representatives who champion the construction partnership at the strategic level.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the designated primary point of contact for the client account. Only one contact per account should be flagged as primary. Used to route official correspondence and contract notifications.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position of the contact within their organisation (e.g., Project Director, Procurement Manager, Chief Engineer). Used to identify the contact's functional role in client engagement and bid management.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent logged activity (call, email, meeting, site visit) with this contact in Salesforce CRM. Used to measure engagement recency and identify at-risk relationships in client retention analytics.

attributes.name: last_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent in-person or virtual meeting held with this contact. Used by account managers to track face-to-face engagement frequency and support relationship health assessments.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the contact record in the source Salesforce CRM system. Used for incremental data loading, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name or surname of the individual stakeholder contact. Combined with first_name to form the full display name used in client-facing communications and CRM reporting.

attributes.name: linkedin_url
attributes.description: LinkedIn professional profile URL for the contact. Used by business development and account management teams for relationship intelligence, stakeholder research, and pre-bid engagement in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile or cell phone number for the contact. Used for urgent site communications, HSE notifications, and out-of-hours contact during critical project milestones.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the contact person associated with the client account.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account managers to record qualitative observations, relationship context, stakeholder preferences, and strategic notes about the contact. Supports informed client engagement and bid strategy preparation.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the contact, including country and area code. Used for direct communication during project execution, bid clarifications, and contract administration.

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred method of communication for project correspondence, meeting invitations, and bid-related notifications. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and used to personalise outreach in opportunity pipeline management.

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code representing the contact's preferred language for written and verbal communication (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'ar', 'zh'). Supports multilingual project environments common in global EPC and infrastructure projects.

attributes.name: relationship_health
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the current health of the business relationship with this contact, as evaluated by the account manager or business development team. Used in CRM pipeline forecasting and client retention strategies.

attributes.name: salutation
attributes.description: Formal honorific or title prefix for the contact (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.) used in official correspondence, contract documents, and client communications.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Origin channel through which this contact was acquired or first identified (e.g., CRM import, referral, industry conference, Request for Proposal (RFP) response, website enquiry, partner introduction). Supports lead source analytics in Salesforce CRM.

products.name: jv_structure
products.description: Defines Joint Venture (JV) arrangements where multiple client entities co-sponsor or co-own a construction project. Captures JV name, lead sponsor, participating entities, equity share percentages, JV agreement reference, governing law, JV type (PPP, BOT, consortium), formation date, dissolution date, and JV management structure. Critical for PPP and BOT project delivery models. Canonical client.jv_structure entity (v2 curated).

attributes.name: jv_structure_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Joint Venture (JV) structure record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary construction project associated with this JV structure. Links the JV arrangement to the project entity for scheduling, cost control, and EVM (Earned Value Management) reporting.

attributes.name: jv_manager_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.contact. Business justification: jv_structure stores jv_manager_name, jv_manager_email, and jv_manager_phone as denormalized STRING fields representing the JV manager contact. Adding jv_manager_contact_id → contact.contact_id normali

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associated opportunity record in Salesforce CRM. Links the JV structure to the bid management and pipeline forecasting process, enabling traceability from opportunity to JV formation.

attributes.name: aconex_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the JV agreement document as registered in the Aconex document management system. Enables direct traceability to the executed legal instrument and associated transmittals.

attributes.name: client_segment
attributes.description: Segmentation of the JV's client or owner base. Distinguishes between public-sector (government-funded), private-sector, PPP (Public-Private Partnership), and BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer) arrangements for CRM analytics and opportunity pipeline management.

attributes.name: country_of_operation
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary country where the JV's construction project is being executed. Used for regulatory compliance, HSE reporting, and geographic portfolio analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the JV structure record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary currency in which the JV's financial obligations, equity contributions, and profit/loss distributions are denominated.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving disputes between JV partners. DAB refers to Dispute Adjudication Board as defined under FIDIC contracts. Drives legal strategy and contract administration.

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the JV was or is scheduled to be dissolved and wound up. Null if the JV is ongoing. Used for financial reporting, DLP (Defects Liability Period) tracking, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: dlp_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the DLP (Defects Liability Period) for the JV's project obligations expires. After this date, the JV's liability for defects under the contract ceases. Critical for contract closeout and financial provisioning.

attributes.name: formation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the JV was formally constituted and the JV agreement became effective. Marks the start of the JV's legal existence and is used for financial reporting under IFRS 11.

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the jurisdiction whose laws govern the JV agreement and dispute resolution. Critical for cross-border JV arrangements and PPP/BOT projects.

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Specific legal jurisdiction or state/province within the governing law country that applies to the JV agreement (e.g., 'New South Wales', 'Dubai International Financial Centre'). Supplements governing_law_country for sub-national jurisdictions.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the JV structure record is currently active and operational. False indicates the JV has been dissolved, superseded, or administratively deactivated. Used for data filtering in reporting and CRM pipeline views.

attributes.name: jv_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or identifier for the executed JV agreement, as registered in Aconex document management or the contract administration system. Used to trace the legal instrument governing the JV.

attributes.name: jv_name
attributes.description: Official registered or trading name of the Joint Venture entity as stated in the JV agreement and used in all project correspondence, bid submissions, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: jv_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier assigned to the JV arrangement, used in contracts, correspondence, and regulatory filings. Sourced from Salesforce CRM or Aconex document management.

attributes.name: jv_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used name for the JV, used in internal reporting, dashboards, and project management systems such as Oracle Primavera P6 and Procore.

attributes.name: jv_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the JV arrangement. 'formation' indicates the JV is being constituted; 'pending' indicates awaiting regulatory or client approval; 'active' indicates fully operational; 'suspended' indicates temporarily halted; 'dissolved' indicates the JV has been wound up.

attributes.name: jv_type
attributes.description: Classification of the JV arrangement by delivery model or legal structure. PPP (Public-Private Partnership), BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer), Consortium, Incorporated JV, Unincorporated JV, or EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction) joint venture. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PPP|BOT|Consortium|Incorporated|Unincorporated|EPC — promote to reference product if additional types are required]

attributes.name: leed_certification_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Target
attributes.description: Target LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification level for the project associated with this JV. Used for sustainability reporting and client commitment tracking.

tag_set.value: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Target

attributes.name: liability_structure
attributes.description: Legal liability arrangement between JV partners as defined in the JV agreement. 'joint_and_several' means each partner is fully liable; 'several_only' means each partner is liable only for their share. Critical for risk management and contract administration.

attributes.name: management_structure_type
attributes.description: Type of governance and management structure adopted by the JV. 'board' indicates a formal board of directors; 'management_committee' indicates a joint committee; 'single_manager' indicates one partner manages on behalf of all; 'co_management' indicates shared management responsibilities.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special conditions, or commentary about the JV arrangement that is not captured in structured fields. Used by contract administrators and project managers.

attributes.name: ntp_date
attributes.description: Date on which the NTP (Notice to Proceed) was issued to the JV, authorising commencement of construction works. Marks the official start of the JV's contractual obligations and is used for schedule baseline management in Oracle Primavera P6.

attributes.name: participant_count
attributes.description: Total number of participating entities (partners or members) in the JV arrangement. Used for governance reporting and to validate completeness of the JV participant roster.

attributes.name: profit_sharing_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which profits and losses are distributed among JV participants. 'equity_proportional' aligns P&L distribution with equity share percentages; 'negotiated' indicates a bespoke arrangement defined in the JV agreement.

attributes.name: project_sector
attributes.description: Primary industry sector of the construction project(s) associated with this JV. Used for client segmentation, pipeline forecasting in Salesforce CRM, and portfolio analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: infrastructure|energy|commercial|residential|industrial|transport|water|healthcare|education — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: registration_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country in which the JV entity is legally registered. May differ from the governing law country for cross-border projects.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official company or entity registration number issued by the relevant government authority for the incorporated JV entity. Applicable for incorporated JV types; null for unincorporated consortia.

attributes.name: total_committed_capital
attributes.description: Total capital committed by all JV participants as stated in the JV agreement, expressed in the JV's primary currency. Used for financial reporting, EBITDA analysis, and project cost control.

attributes.name: total_equity_pct
attributes.description: Sum of all participating entities' equity share percentages in the JV. Must equal 100.00% for a fully constituted JV. Used as a validation and audit control field.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the JV structure record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses associated with client accounts, including registered office, billing address, project site liaison office, and correspondence address. Captures address type, street, city, state/province, postal code, country, GIS coordinates, and address validation status. Supports multi-jurisdiction clients operating across regions. Canonical client.address entity (v2 curated).

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client address record in the Construction data platform. Serves as the primary key for the client_address entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent client account to which this address belongs. Links the address record to the client master in the CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system (Salesforce CRM).

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active indicates the address is in current use; inactive means it is no longer used; pending_validation awaits address verification; superseded means it has been replaced by a newer address; undeliverable indicates mail or correspondence has been returned.

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classifies the functional purpose of the address. Registered office is the legal domicile; billing is used for invoice delivery; correspondence is the preferred mailing address; project_site_liaison is the on-site contact office for a specific project; head_office and branch_office denote organisational hierarchy locations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: registered_office|billing|correspondence|project_site_liaison|head_office|branch_office — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: attention_to
attributes.description: Name of the specific individual or department to whom correspondence should be directed at this address (e.g., 'Attn: Contracts Manager' or 'Attn: Finance Department'). Used in formal contract correspondence and RFI (Request for Information) transmittals.

attributes.name: building_name
attributes.description: Name of the building or complex at this address (e.g., 'Empire State Building', 'One Canada Square', 'Dubai World Trade Centre'). Used for precise address identification in dense urban environments and for formal correspondence headers.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: Name of the city, town, or municipality in which the address is located. Used for regional client segmentation, jurisdiction determination, and multi-city project coordination.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the address (e.g., USA, GBR, AUS, ARE). Supports multi-jurisdiction client management across global construction operations including EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) and PPP (Public-Private Partnership) projects.

attributes.name: country_name
attributes.description: Full English name of the country corresponding to the country_code. Stored for display and reporting purposes to avoid repeated lookups against the ISO country reference table.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the data platform. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data governance and GDPR compliance tracking.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this address became or becomes effective for the client. Supports temporal address management, enabling historical address tracking for contract administration and legal notice purposes.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this address ceases to be effective for the client. Null indicates the address is currently active with no planned end date. Used for temporal address history management and superseded address tracking.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: General email address associated with this address location (e.g., a departmental or office inbox). Used for electronic correspondence, transmittal delivery via Aconex, and formal notice under contract. Distinct from individual contact email addresses.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number associated with this address location. Retained for clients and jurisdictions where fax remains a legally recognised method of formal notice delivery under FIDIC contract conditions.

attributes.name: floor_level
attributes.description: Floor or level number within a building at this address (e.g., 'Level 12', 'Ground Floor', 'Basement 2'). Used for precise delivery instructions and visitor access coordination for client site visits.

attributes.name: format_type
attributes.description: Indicates the structural format of the address to support correct rendering and printing. Western follows street-city-state-postal conventions; eastern follows country-specific formats (e.g., Japan, China); po_box is a post office box address; free_form is an unstructured address entry.

attributes.name: is_billing_address
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is designated as the billing address for invoice delivery and accounts receivable correspondence. Used by SAP S/4HANA AR (Accounts Receivable) module for invoice routing.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the primary address for the client account. Only one address per client should be flagged as primary at any given time. Used to determine the default address for correspondence and contract documentation.

attributes.name: is_registered_office
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the legally registered office address of the client entity. Required for contract execution, legal notices under FIDIC conditions, and regulatory compliance filings.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Legal and regulatory jurisdiction code applicable to this address, combining ISO 3166-1 country code and subdivision code (e.g., US-CA for California, AU-NSW for New South Wales). Used for tax jurisdiction mapping, OSHA/EPA regulatory compliance, and contract law determination.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Supports GIS (Geographic Information System) mapping, proximity analysis to active construction sites, and spatial analytics for project planning.

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including building number, street name, and suite or unit number. Represents the first line of the postal address as used in official correspondence and contract documentation.

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as floor number, building name, industrial estate, or campus identifier. Optional field used when the primary line is insufficient.

attributes.name: line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line used for additional locality or district information, particularly relevant for international clients in regions where addresses require more than two street lines.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Used in conjunction with latitude for GIS (Geographic Information System) spatial analysis, site proximity calculations, and mapping of client office locations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional address-related notes or delivery instructions (e.g., 'Security clearance required for entry', 'Use rear entrance', 'Deliveries accepted Monday-Friday only'). Supports operational coordination for site visits and document deliveries.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number associated with this address location. Used for direct contact with the client office at this address for project coordination, site liaison, and contract administration purposes.

attributes.name: po_box_number
attributes.description: Post Office (PO) Box number for clients who receive correspondence via a PO Box rather than a street address. Common for government agencies, public-sector clients, and clients in regions where PO Box delivery is standard.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the address. Used for mail routing, geographic clustering of clients, and regional analytics. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit US ZIP, alphanumeric UK postcode).

attributes.name: preferred_correspondence_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-2 language code indicating the preferred language for correspondence sent to this address (e.g., 'en' for English, 'fr' for French, 'ar' for Arabic). Supports multilingual client communication in international construction markets.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Broad geographic region grouping for the address (e.g., North America, Middle East, Asia Pacific, Europe). Used for regional portfolio reporting, business development segmentation, and PMO (Project Management Office) territory alignment.

attributes.name: source_system_address_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this address record in the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce CRM Address ID, SAP S/4HANA partner address number). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system deduplication.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, territory, or region within the country. Used for regulatory jurisdiction mapping, tax compliance, and regional reporting across multi-jurisdiction construction clients.

attributes.name: suite_unit_number
attributes.description: Suite, unit, or office number within a building at this address. Provides the final level of address precision for multi-tenant buildings where multiple client offices may occupy the same floor.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Specific tax jurisdiction code for the address as used in SAP S/4HANA tax determination. May differ from the general jurisdiction code in federal/state/local tax overlay scenarios. Used for sales tax, VAT, and withholding tax calculations on client invoices.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, Asia/Dubai, Australia/Sydney). Used for scheduling client communications, meeting coordination, and project milestone notifications across global construction operations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change detection, incremental data loading in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the address was last validated against a postal authority or address verification service. Used to schedule re-validation cycles and assess data quality freshness.

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: Name of the service or system used to validate the address (e.g., USPS, Google Maps API, Loqate, SmartyStreets). Provides traceability for data quality audits and vendor management.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Result of the address validation process against a postal authority or third-party address verification service. Validated means the address has been confirmed as deliverable; not_validated means validation has not been attempted; failed means the address could not be verified; partial means only some components were verified.

products.name: opportunity
products.description: Pre-award commercial opportunity record tracking potential construction projects in the BD pipeline. Captures opportunity name, client account, project type, estimated contract value, delivery model (EPC, GMP, DBB, PPP), bid/no-bid decision, probability of win, expected NTP date, pipeline stage, BD owner, and win/loss outcome. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Opportunity object. SSOT for pipeline forecasting. Canonical client.client_opportunity entity (v2 curated).

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the client opportunity record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the client_opportunity data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account (project owner, developer, or sponsor) associated with this opportunity. Maps to the Salesforce CRM Account object.

attributes.name: actual_award_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract was formally awarded. Populated upon win outcome. Used for win/loss analysis and BD cycle time measurement.

attributes.name: bid_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Internal estimate of the cost to prepare and submit the bid (tendering cost), including estimating, engineering, and proposal resources. Used for bid cost tracking and ROI analysis on BD spend.

attributes.name: bid_no_bid_decision
attributes.description: Formal decision outcome from the bid/no-bid review process indicating whether the company will pursue this opportunity. Pending_review indicates the decision gate has not yet been completed.

attributes.name: bid_no_bid_decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal bid/no-bid decision was made and recorded. Used for governance audit trails and BD cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: bid_submission_date
attributes.description: Actual or planned date on which the bid/tender/proposal was or is to be submitted to the client. Critical scheduling milestone for BD and estimating teams.

attributes.name: bim_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client mandates Building Information Modeling (BIM) as a project delivery requirement. True = BIM is contractually required. Drives technology and resource planning for the bid.

attributes.name: boq_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Bill of Quantities (BOQ) has been issued by the client as part of the tender package. True = BOQ provided; False = lump-sum or design-build without BOQ. Affects estimating approach and bid strategy.

attributes.name: client_opportunity_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the scope, nature, and key characteristics of the construction opportunity. Provides context for BD team members reviewing the pipeline and supports AI/ML-based opportunity classification.

attributes.name: competitor_names
attributes.description: Names of known competing firms bidding on the same opportunity. Free-text or comma-separated list. Confidential competitive intelligence used for bid strategy and market positioning analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the opportunity record was first created in the source CRM system. Represents the business event of opportunity identification and entry into the BD pipeline. Used for pipeline age and BD cycle time analytics.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated contract value and weighted pipeline value (e.g., USD, EUR, AED, GBP). Required for multi-currency pipeline consolidation.

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: Contract delivery model under which the construction project will be executed. EPC = Engineering Procurement and Construction; GMP = Guaranteed Maximum Price; DBB = Design-Bid-Build; DB = Design-Build; PPP = Public-Private Partnership; BOT = Build-Operate-Transfer; FIDIC = FIDIC-based contract. Drives risk allocation and commercial strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EPC|GMP|DBB|DB|PPP|BOT|FIDIC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: esg_requirements
attributes.description: Description of any Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) requirements specified by the client for this opportunity (e.g., carbon targets, local content requirements, diversity commitments). Free-text field for BD qualification notes.

attributes.name: estimated_contract_value
attributes.description: Estimated total contract value of the opportunity in the reporting currency. Used for pipeline forecasting, revenue planning, and bid/no-bid decision thresholds. Raw commercial estimate; not a committed figure.

attributes.name: expected_award_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date on which the contract is expected to be formally awarded to the company. Used for pipeline close-date forecasting and resource mobilization planning.

attributes.name: expected_ntp_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date on which the client will issue the Notice to Proceed (NTP), authorizing the start of construction work. Used for resource planning and revenue recognition scheduling.

attributes.name: is_jv_bid
attributes.description: Indicates whether this opportunity is being pursued as a Joint Venture (JV) arrangement. True = JV bid; False = sole-entity bid. Drives JV governance and risk review processes.

attributes.name: jv_partner_names
attributes.description: Names of Joint Venture (JV) partners with whom the company intends to bid on this opportunity. Relevant for JV-structured bids common in large infrastructure and EPC projects. Confidential commercial information.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the opportunity record in the source CRM system. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental pipeline loads.

attributes.name: leed_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification for the project. True = LEED certification is a contract requirement. Drives sustainability planning and cost estimation.

attributes.name: loss_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the opportunity was lost or withdrawn (e.g., price, technical score, client relationship, competitor strength, scope mismatch). Populated when win_loss_outcome is 'lost' or 'withdrawn'. Used for BD lessons-learned and competitive intelligence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price|technical_score|client_relationship|competitor_strength|scope_mismatch|capacity|no_bid_decision|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the construction opportunity, typically including the project name and client name (e.g., 'Greenfield Highway Extension – ADOT'). Used for identification in pipeline reports and BD dashboards.

attributes.name: next_action
attributes.description: Description of the next planned business development action required to advance this opportunity (e.g., 'Submit EOI by 15-Mar', 'Attend client briefing', 'Complete bid/no-bid review'). Operational field used by BD team for pipeline management.

attributes.name: next_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the next business development action must be completed. Used for BD pipeline hygiene, follow-up scheduling, and opportunity stagnation alerts.

attributes.name: opportunity_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier for the opportunity as assigned in Salesforce CRM. Used for cross-system reference and client-facing communications.

attributes.name: opportunity_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the opportunity record indicating whether it is actively pursued, won, lost, on hold, or cancelled. Distinct from pipeline_stage which tracks the BD workflow step.

attributes.name: pipeline_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the opportunity in the business development pipeline. Drives pipeline forecasting and BD reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: prospect|qualification|bid_preparation|submitted|negotiation|awarded|lost|no_bid — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: prequalification_status
attributes.description: Status of the company's prequalification with the client for this opportunity. Many public-sector and large private clients require formal prequalification before bid submission. Drives eligibility gating in the BD pipeline.

attributes.name: probability_of_win_pct
attributes.description: Estimated probability (0–100%) that the company will be awarded this contract. Used to calculate weighted pipeline value for revenue forecasting. Assigned by the BD owner and reviewed at stage gates.

attributes.name: project_duration_months
attributes.description: Estimated duration of the construction project in months from NTP to practical completion. Used for resource planning, revenue phasing, and schedule risk assessment.

attributes.name: project_location_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the construction project will be executed (e.g., USA, ARE, GBR). Used for geographic pipeline analysis and regulatory compliance scoping.

attributes.name: project_location_region
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the construction project will be executed. Used for regional pipeline reporting, resource planning, and jurisdictional compliance (e.g., OSHA state plans, local building codes).

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the construction project type (e.g., highway, airport, bridge, power plant, residential, commercial, industrial). Used for market segmentation and capability matching. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: highway|airport|bridge|power_plant|residential|commercial|industrial|water_treatment|rail|data_center — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rfp_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the client issued the Request for Proposal (RFP) or Invitation to Tender (ITT). Marks the formal start of the bid preparation phase.

attributes.name: rfq_number
attributes.description: Client-issued Request for Quotation (RFQ) or Request for Proposal (RFP) reference number. Used for cross-referencing with client procurement documents and Aconex correspondence.

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Sector classification of the client commissioning the work: public-sector (government/municipal), private-sector (developer/corporate), or PPP/BOT (public-private partnership or build-operate-transfer arrangement). Used for client segmentation and reporting.

attributes.name: source_crm_opportunity_code
attributes.description: Original opportunity identifier from the Salesforce CRM system of record. Used for data lineage, cross-system reconciliation, and traceability back to the operational source.

attributes.name: strategic_priority
attributes.description: Internal strategic priority classification assigned to this opportunity by BD leadership. Tier 1 = highest strategic importance (must-win); Tier 2 = important but not critical; Tier 3 = opportunistic. Drives resource allocation for bid preparation.

attributes.name: weighted_pipeline_value
attributes.description: Estimated contract value multiplied by the probability of win percentage, representing the risk-adjusted contribution of this opportunity to the revenue forecast. Key metric for executive pipeline reporting.

attributes.name: win_loss_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the opportunity after the bid process concludes. Won = contract awarded to company; Lost = awarded to competitor; Withdrawn = company withdrew bid; No_award = client cancelled procurement. Drives win rate analytics and BD performance reporting.

products.name: interaction
products.description: Log of all formal and informal interactions between the organization and client stakeholders, including meetings, site visits, calls, presentations, entertainment events, and formal correspondence. Captures interaction type, date, duration, participants (internal and external), topics discussed, action items with owners, follow-up due date, interaction outcome, sentiment indicator, and linked opportunity or project reference. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Activity/Task/Event objects. Supports relationship history tracking, account review preparation, and BD activity KPI reporting (interactions per account per quarter). Canonical client.interaction entity (v2 curated).

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client interaction record in the silver layer. Primary key for the client_interaction data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account (owner, developer, or sponsor) associated with this interaction. Maps to the Salesforce CRM Account object.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Contract execution CRM: client interactions during contract delivery (variation negotiations, EOT discussions, payment dispute meetings) must be traceable to the specific agreement for contract corres

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active construction project linked to this interaction, if applicable. Supports relationship history tracking against live project engagements.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary client-side stakeholder contact who participated in this interaction. Maps to the Salesforce CRM Contact object.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business development opportunity linked to this interaction, if applicable. Supports pipeline tracking and BD activity KPI reporting. Maps to Salesforce CRM Opportunity object.

attributes.name: schedule_milestone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.schedule_milestone. Business justification: Client interactions (milestone review meetings, handover walkthroughs, witness inspections) are directly triggered by schedule milestones. Linking interaction to schedule_milestone enables milestone-d

attributes.name: action_item_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person (internal or client-side) responsible for completing the primary action item arising from this interaction.

attributes.name: action_items
attributes.description: Free-text description of agreed action items arising from the interaction, including the responsible party and expected completion date. Supports follow-up tracking and accountability management.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Medium through which the interaction was conducted. Distinguishes in-person, virtual (video conference), hybrid, or phone-only engagements. Supports channel mix analytics for BD strategy.

attributes.name: client_seniority_level
attributes.description: Highest seniority level of client-side attendees present at the interaction (e.g., C-Suite, VP/Director, Manager). Supports executive engagement tracking and account strategy analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interaction record was first created in the source CRM system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: crm_activity_code
attributes.description: External identifier from the Salesforce CRM Activity, Task, or Event object that is the source of record for this interaction. Enables traceability back to the originating system.

attributes.name: crm_record_type
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM object type from which this interaction record was sourced (Task, Event, Call Log, or Email Log). Supports data lineage and source system traceability.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the entertainment cost amount (e.g., USD, AUD, GBP). Supports multi-currency expense reporting.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the interaction including agenda, topics discussed, key decisions made, and context. Supports account review preparation and relationship history tracking.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the interaction in minutes as recorded by the interaction owner. May be entered directly or derived from start/end timestamps. Supports engagement intensity analysis.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the interaction concluded. Used in conjunction with start timestamp to derive interaction duration for BD activity analytics.

attributes.name: entertainment_cost
attributes.description: Monetary cost incurred for client entertainment events associated with this interaction (e.g., business dinners, hospitality). Subject to anti-bribery and gifts policy compliance. Stored in the organisation's base currency.

attributes.name: external_attendee_count
attributes.description: Total number of client-side or third-party participants in the interaction. Supports stakeholder engagement breadth analysis.

attributes.name: external_attendees
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of client-side or third-party attendees (names and organisations) who participated in the interaction. Supports stakeholder mapping and relationship history tracking.

attributes.name: followup_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required follow-up action arising from this interaction has been completed. Supports BD activity compliance and pipeline hygiene reporting.

attributes.name: followup_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the follow-up action or next interaction should be completed. Used for BD pipeline management and relationship cadence monitoring.

attributes.name: gifts_hospitality_declared
attributes.description: Indicates whether any gifts or hospitality provided during this interaction have been formally declared in accordance with the organisation's anti-bribery and corruption policy. Supports compliance and audit requirements.

attributes.name: interaction_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the interaction took place or is scheduled to take place. Used for BD activity KPI reporting (interactions per account per quarter).

attributes.name: interaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the interaction record. Indicates whether the interaction was planned, successfully completed, cancelled, rescheduled, or resulted in a no-show.

attributes.name: interaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interaction channel or format. Distinguishes formal meetings, site visits, phone calls, presentations, entertainment events, and formal correspondence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: meeting|site_visit|phone_call|presentation|entertainment|correspondence|video_call|email|workshop|conference — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: internal_attendee_count
attributes.description: Total number of internal employees who participated in the interaction. Supports BD resource allocation analysis and engagement intensity KPIs.

attributes.name: internal_attendees
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of internal employees (names or employee IDs) who participated in the interaction. Supports account review preparation and engagement coverage analysis.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the time or cost associated with this interaction is billable to the client or project. Relevant for reimbursable contract types (e.g., cost-plus, EPC reimbursable).

attributes.name: is_executive_engagement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interaction involved C-suite or executive-level participants from either the internal organisation or the client side. Supports executive engagement KPI reporting and account strategy reviews.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interaction record was last updated in the source CRM system. Supports incremental data loading and change data capture in the silver layer.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the interaction took place (e.g., client head office address, project site name, video conference platform). Maps to Salesforce CRM Event Location field.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or observations recorded by the interaction owner that supplement the main description. May include informal observations, relationship nuances, or contextual background not captured elsewhere.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Overall result or conclusion of the interaction as assessed by the interaction owner. Indicates whether the engagement moved the relationship or opportunity forward, was neutral, or raised concerns requiring escalation.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Primary business purpose or intent of the interaction. Distinguishes relationship-building activities from bid pursuit, project review, issue resolution, contract negotiation, or commissioning and handover discussions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: relationship_building|bid_pursuit|project_review|issue_resolution|contract_negotiation|handover|technical_review|commercial_discussion — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sentiment_indicator
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the client's sentiment or disposition observed during the interaction, as recorded by the interaction owner. Supports relationship health monitoring and account review preparation.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the interaction commenced. Supports duration calculation and scheduling analytics. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Event start datetime.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief title or subject line summarising the purpose of the interaction (e.g., 'Q3 Project Review Meeting', 'RFP Clarification Call'). Maps to Salesforce CRM Activity Subject field.

attributes.name: topics_discussed
attributes.description: Structured or free-text list of key topics covered during the interaction (e.g., contract scope, change orders, project schedule, new bid opportunities, relationship concerns). Supports thematic analysis of client engagement.

products.name: project_engagement
products.description: Bridge record linking a client account to a specific construction project they commission, sponsor, or fund. Captures client role (owner, co-sponsor, JV lead, funding agency, end-user), engagement start and end dates, primary client representative, contract reference, engagement status, and satisfaction indicators. SSOT for which clients are involved in which projects from the client domain perspective. Does not duplicate project master data owned by the project domain. Canonical client.project_engagement entity (v2 curated).

attributes.name: project_engagement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the client project engagement record. Primary key for this bridge entity linking a client account to a specific construction project.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account (owner, developer, sponsor, or funding agency) involved in this engagement. Links to the client master record.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project that this client is commissioning, sponsoring, or funding. Links to the project master record.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary contact person designated by the client to represent their interests on this project. Typically the client-side project manager or authorized representative.

attributes.name: framework_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_framework_agreement. Business justification: Project engagements in construction are frequently placed as call-offs under a master framework agreement. Linking project_engagement to client_framework_agreement enables framework utilization tracki

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: The opportunity identifier from the Salesforce CRM system that tracks the sales pipeline record associated with this engagement. Enables traceability from opportunity pursuit through to active project delivery.

attributes.name: advance_payment_amount
attributes.description: The value of any advance payment made by the client to the contractor at the commencement of this engagement, typically secured by an advance payment guarantee. Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: approved_variation_value
attributes.description: The cumulative value of all approved Change Orders (CO) / variations issued by the client on this engagement to date. Reflects the net adjustment to the original contract value due to scope changes.

attributes.name: bid_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number assigned to the original bid or tender submission (RFP/RFQ response) that led to this engagement being awarded. Links the engagement back to the opportunity pipeline in the CRM.

attributes.name: bim_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has mandated Building Information Modeling (BIM) as a contractual deliverable requirement for this engagement. Drives BIM execution plan obligations and Autodesk BIM 360 usage.

attributes.name: client_role
attributes.description: The functional role the client plays in this project engagement. Distinguishes between the primary owner, co-sponsor in a joint venture (JV), lead JV partner, funding agency (e.g., government body), end-user of the completed asset, or developer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: owner|co_sponsor|jv_lead|funding_agency|end_user|developer|ppp_authority|bot_concessionaire — promote to reference product if additional roles are needed]

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: The client's preferred channel for formal project communications and correspondence on this engagement. Determines how RFIs, submittals, transmittals, and official notices are delivered.

attributes.name: contract_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the contract value and financial commitments in this engagement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AED). Required for multi-currency project reporting and IFRS/GAAP compliance.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: The externally-known contract number or agreement reference assigned to the governing contract for this engagement. Used for cross-referencing with contract administration systems and client correspondence.

attributes.name: contract_value
attributes.description: The total awarded contract value for this client-project engagement as agreed at contract execution. Represents the baseline financial commitment from the client. Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this client-project engagement record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data governance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current status of any formal contractual dispute between the client and the contractor on this engagement. Tracks the dispute resolution lifecycle from initial notice through negotiation, adjudication, or arbitration to resolution.

attributes.name: dlp_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Defects Liability Period (DLP) expires, after which the contractor's obligation to rectify defects at no cost to the client ceases. Critical for contract close-out and final account settlement.

attributes.name: engagement_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client's formal involvement in the project is expected to conclude or has concluded. Typically aligned with project handover, Defects Liability Period (DLP) expiry, or BOT concession end date. Nullable for open-ended engagements.

attributes.name: engagement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing qualitative notes, special conditions, or contextual information relevant to this client-project engagement that are not captured in structured fields. Used by account managers and project directors.

attributes.name: engagement_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this client-project engagement. Used in correspondence, transmittals, and CRM tracking to uniquely identify the engagement across systems.

attributes.name: engagement_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client's formal involvement in the project commenced. Typically aligned with the Notice to Proceed (NTP) date or the contract execution date.

attributes.name: engagement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the client-project engagement. Tracks whether the engagement is actively ongoing, pending formal commencement (awaiting NTP), on hold, completed at project handover, terminated early, or cancelled prior to commencement.

attributes.name: engagement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contractual or commercial arrangement type governing this engagement. Reflects the delivery model: EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction), Design-Build (DB), Design-Bid-Build (DBB), Public-Private Partnership (PPP), Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP), framework agreement, or direct award. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: epc|design_build|design_bid_build|ppp|bot|gmp|framework|direct_award — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: eot_days_granted
attributes.description: The total number of calendar days of Extension of Time (EOT) formally granted by the client to the contractor on this engagement to date. Adjusts the contractual completion date and affects LD exposure.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Classification of the primary funding mechanism used by the client to finance this project engagement. Supports financial risk assessment and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: government_grant|private_equity|bank_loan|bond_issuance|multilateral|internal_budget|mixed|ppp_concession — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: handover_date
attributes.description: The actual or planned date on which the completed project asset was or is expected to be handed over to the client. Marks the transition from construction to the Defects Liability Period (DLP) or Operations and Maintenance (O&M) phase.

attributes.name: hse_requirements_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Requirements Classification
attributes.description: Classification of the HSE (Health, Safety and Environment) requirements imposed by the client for this engagement. Reflects the risk profile and regulatory environment: standard (baseline OSHA/ISO 45001), enhanced (client-specific elevated requirements), or critical (high-hazard environments such as nuclear, offshore, or major infrastructure).

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Requirements Classification

attributes.name: insurance_compliance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractor's required insurance policies (e.g., professional indemnity, public liability, contractor's all-risk) have been verified as compliant with the client's contractual requirements for this engagement.

attributes.name: jv_participation_percentage
attributes.description: The client's ownership or participation share percentage in a Joint Venture (JV) arrangement for this project. Applicable when the client role is co-sponsor or JV lead. Null for sole-owner engagements.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this client-project engagement record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: leed_certification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has mandated LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification for the project deliverable as a contractual requirement in this engagement.

tag_set.value: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Required

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_rate
attributes.description: The contractually agreed daily or weekly Liquidated Damages (LD) rate payable by the contractor to the client in the event of project delay beyond the agreed completion date. Expressed in the contract currency per day.

attributes.name: ntp_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Notice to Proceed (NTP) was formally issued by the client to the contractor, authorizing commencement of construction works. A critical contractual milestone in the engagement lifecycle.

attributes.name: performance_bond_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has required the contractor to provide a performance bond as a financial security instrument for this engagement. Affects contract financial structuring and risk management.

attributes.name: procurement_method
attributes.description: The procurement route used by the client to award this engagement. Indicates whether the contract was awarded through open tender, selective tender, direct negotiation, Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), or a framework call-off.

attributes.name: relationship_tier
attributes.description: Segmentation tier assigned to this client engagement based on strategic importance, revenue contribution, and long-term relationship value. Drives account management priority and resource allocation.

attributes.name: repeat_client
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client has previously engaged the construction company on one or more prior projects. Supports client relationship analytics, win-rate reporting, and strategic account management.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The agreed frequency at which formal project progress reports are submitted to the client for this engagement. Governs the reporting cadence for schedule, cost, and HSE performance updates.

attributes.name: retention_percentage
attributes.description: The contractually agreed retention percentage withheld by the client from each progress payment as a performance security. Typically released in two tranches: at practical completion and at DLP expiry.

attributes.name: satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the client's satisfaction with the construction company's performance on this engagement, typically captured through formal client satisfaction surveys. Scored on a standardized scale (e.g., 1.00–5.00 or 0.00–10.00).

attributes.name: satisfaction_survey_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent client satisfaction survey was conducted for this engagement. Used to track the currency of satisfaction data and schedule follow-up surveys.

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Sector classification of the client for this engagement: public-sector (government/municipal), private-sector (commercial developer or corporation), or PPP (Public-Private Partnership arrangement). Supports client segmentation and reporting.

products.name: prequalification
products.description: Records prequalification and due diligence assessments that client organizations apply to the construction firm before issuing RFPs or RFQs. Captures prequalification reference number, client account, category (civil, MEP, EPC, marine, tunneling), submission date, expiry date, status (approved, conditional, rejected, expired), conditions imposed, approving authority, and required renewal actions. Critical for bid eligibility tracking — the firm cannot bid on work from a client without active prequalification in the relevant category. Canonical client.client_prequalification entity (v2 curated).

attributes.name: prequalification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client prequalification record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.contact. Business justification: client_prequalification stores client_contact_name (STRING) and client_contact_email (STRING) as denormalized fields representing the client-side contact for the prequalification process. Adding conta

attributes.name: primary_client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client/owner organization that issued this prequalification assessment. Links to the master client account record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client organization formally approved or conditionally approved the prequalification. Null if not yet approved or if rejected.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: Name or designation of the client-side authority (individual, committee, or department) that reviewed and approved or rejected the prequalification submission.

attributes.name: condition_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date by which all imposed conditions must be resolved or evidenced to the client to convert a conditional approval to full approval.

attributes.name: conditions_imposed
attributes.description: Free-text description of any conditions, restrictions, or requirements imposed by the client as part of a conditional prequalification approval. Null if unconditionally approved.

attributes.name: contract_delivery_method
attributes.description: The project delivery method for which this prequalification applies: Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC), Design-Build (DB), Design-Bid-Build (DBB), Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP), Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), or Public-Private Partnership (PPP).

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary jurisdiction in which this prequalification is applicable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this prequalification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the maximum project value and any financial thresholds in this prequalification record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AED).

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the prequalification submission document package as stored in the document management system (e.g., Aconex transmittal number or document register ID).

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which the prequalification becomes valid and the firm is eligible to bid on work from this client in the specified category.

attributes.name: environmental_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires ISO 14001 or equivalent environmental management certification as part of the prequalification criteria.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the prequalification ceases to be valid. After this date, the firm is no longer eligible to bid unless renewed. Critical for bid eligibility tracking.

attributes.name: financial_audit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires submission of audited financial statements as part of the prequalification documentation package.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic region, country, or territory for which this prequalification is valid. Prequalification may be limited to specific jurisdictions or project locations.

attributes.name: hse_certification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Certification Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires valid HSE certifications (e.g., ISO 45001, OSHA compliance) as a mandatory condition of prequalification in this category.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Certification Required

attributes.name: insurance_verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires proof of adequate insurance coverage (professional indemnity, public liability, workers compensation) as a prequalification condition.

attributes.name: leed_certification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires LEED certification or demonstrated LEED project experience as a prequalification criterion for sustainable construction projects.

tag_set.value: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Required

attributes.name: max_project_value
attributes.description: The maximum single-project contract value (in the specified currency) for which the firm is prequalified by this client. Bids exceeding this threshold require separate approval or re-prequalification.

attributes.name: minimum_passing_score
attributes.description: The minimum score threshold set by the client that the construction firm must achieve to receive an approved prequalification status in this category.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, internal observations, or strategic notes related to this prequalification record. Confidential as it may contain competitive intelligence.

attributes.name: prequalification_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned by the client organization to this prequalification submission. Used in all correspondence and bid eligibility checks.

attributes.name: prequalification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the prequalification record. Determines bid eligibility — only 'approved' or 'conditional' statuses permit the firm to submit bids for the client in the relevant category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: approved|conditional|rejected|expired|pending|withdrawn — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: Classification of the client procurement arrangement type: public sector, private sector, Public-Private Partnership (PPP), Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), or Joint Venture (JV). Drives compliance and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: quality_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client mandates a valid ISO 9001 or equivalent quality management system certification as a prequalification requirement.

attributes.name: reference_projects_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of comparable completed projects the client requires the firm to demonstrate as part of the prequalification submission.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the client for rejecting the prequalification submission. Populated only when prequalification_status is 'rejected'. Used for gap analysis and resubmission planning.

attributes.name: renewal_actions_required
attributes.description: Free-text description of specific actions, documentation updates, or re-submissions required by the client to successfully renew this prequalification.

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the firm must initiate the renewal process to maintain uninterrupted prequalification status. Typically set before the expiry date to allow processing time.

attributes.name: renewal_period_months
attributes.description: The duration in months of each prequalification validity period before renewal is required. Typically 12, 24, or 36 months depending on client policy.

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this prequalification requires periodic renewal to remain valid, as opposed to a one-time permanent approval.

attributes.name: rfp_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the firm is currently eligible to receive and respond to RFPs from this client in the specified work category, based on active prequalification status.

attributes.name: rfq_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the firm is currently eligible to receive and respond to RFQs from this client in the specified work category, based on active prequalification status.

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Numeric score assigned by the client during the prequalification evaluation, typically on a 0–100 scale. Used to rank and compare contractors. Confidential as it reflects competitive assessment.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the construction firm formally submitted its prequalification documentation package to the client organization.

attributes.name: submitted_trir
attributes.description: The firm's actual TRIR value submitted as part of the prequalification documentation, typically based on the most recent 12-month or 3-year rolling average.

attributes.name: trir_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR) the client permits for prequalification. If the firm's TRIR exceeds this value, prequalification may be denied or revoked.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this prequalification record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and Silver Layer incremental processing.

attributes.name: work_category
attributes.description: The construction discipline or scope category for which prequalification has been assessed (e.g., civil, MEP, EPC, marine, tunneling, structural, roads, bridges). Determines which types of RFPs/RFQs the firm is eligible to bid on. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: civil|mep|epc|marine|tunneling|structural|roads|bridges|power|rail — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: years_experience_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant construction experience in the specified work category that the client requires for prequalification.

products.name: account_credit_profile
products.description: Financial creditworthiness and payment behavior profile for each client account, supporting contract terms negotiation and financial risk management. Captures credit limit, approved payment terms (net 30/60/90), average payment days (DSO), overdue balance, external credit rating (D&B, S&P), internal credit score, last credit review date, payment history rating, credit hold status, special payment arrangements (retention release schedules, milestone-based payments), and sovereign risk indicator for government clients. Updated periodically by finance with input from BD for relationship context. Canonical client.account_credit_profile entity (v2 curated).

attributes.name: account_credit_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the account credit profile record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: primary_client_account_id
